newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 22.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Moslem extremists threaten to increase violence in Algeria during the Moslem holy month of Ramadan.
-- Unions and mediator at Credit Foncier still negotiating over planned restructuring.

-- Dollar breaks ceiling of 5.5 dollar to the franc, a rise which is expected to stimulate French exports and may trigger a surge in company investments if it proves a long-term trend. Some experts fear impact of a higher energy bill, say dollar rise may put a halt to interest rate cuts in Europe.
